messages:
Lina (Marketing): Quick kickoff: we need a compact enterprise one-pager focused on security + SLA choices, plus 2x benchmark callouts for webinar slides and a routing snippet for inbound leads. Ship to field by next Wed. Who owns which piece?

Trevor (Sales Ops): I'll map lead routing rules. Suggestion: trigger keywords -> escalations to AE + Field SE. Also add a "pilot interest" tag to route faster.

Maya (Product): I will provide short, legal-safe deploy blurbs: Hosted, Dedicated (reserved), Private (VPC/on-prem). Will include bullet on encryption and key management. ETA: Mon noon.

Ibrahim (Eng): I'll export two graphs: p95 latency by mode and cost per 1k tokens by model family. Will include test notes (batching off, 1k token seq). Link when done.

Ruth (Field SE): I'll draft a 6-item security checklist and 3 short battle-card answers for AE. Also propose lead routing: if "private" + "SLA" in notes -> immediate AE queue.

Lina (Marketing): For the one-pager: top claim, 4 security bullets, small deploy-mode diagram (icons), two benchmark callouts, CTA + routing appendix. Keep copy punchy.

Sam (Design): I'll make a single A4 + two 16:9 slides (light bg). Need final copy Tue EOD to deliver Wed morning art.

Trevor (Sales Ops): Routing rules draft: default -> SDR. If message contains any of [private, on-prem, SOC2, HIPAA, SLA, HSM] -> tag enterprise -> AE + Field SE. If customer requests artifacts -> tag security-review -> Customer Security + AE.

Maya (Product): SLA blurb (draft): "Dedicated customers: uptime SLA 99.95% with enterprise support and escalation. Latency targets published per model and workload profile." Sending to @legal-bot for review.

legal-bot: Noted. We will review SLA language; please avoid absolute promises about data residency without contract attachments. Allow 24-48h.

Ibrahim (Eng): Bench notes: Hosted p95 ~125ms, Dedicated p95 ~80ms, Private on-prem ~100ms (varies by infra). Cost examples depend on quantization; slide will show relative bars, not exact prices. PNGs 1200x800.

Ruth (Field SE): Battle-card Qs (short):
- "Can we keep data in our VPC?" -> Yes with Private; see integration checklist.
- "Do you rotate keys?" -> Integrates with KMS/HSM, customer controls rotation policy.
- "What happens on SLA breach?" -> 24/7 escalation + service credits per contract.

Lina (Marketing): Also need 3 email subject lines and a 1-line webinar teaser. Trevor/Sales Ops want AB options.

Trevor (Sales Ops): Subjects (tone variants):
1) "Predictable, SLA-backed LLM inference for regulated teams"
2) "Secure deployments: Hosted, Dedicated, or Private — pick what fits"
3) "Book a security review & 2-week Dedicated pilot"

Lina (Marketing): Webinar teaser (1-liner): "30-min briefing: How enterprise teams get secure, cost-effective LLM inference with SLAs and private deployment options."

Sam (Design): Dropping placeholders in folder: https://drive.google.com/enterprise-security-pack. Please add final copy.

Lina (Marketing): Timeline recap:
- Product deploy copy: Maya  Mon noon
- Bench exports: Ibrahim  Mon EOD
- Field SE checklist & battle cards: Ruth  Tue morning
- Design assets: Sam  Tue EOD
- Legal SLA review: legal-bot  Tue/Wed
- Ship to field: Wed EOD

Maya (Product): One more note: include a tiny section "excluded items": training-data provenance guarantees and third-party model license disputes. Keep it short.

Lina (Marketing): Great. If there are no objections I'll lock this and start drafting the one-pager intro copy. Ping here for edits. Thanks :rocket:
